## What changes on screen?

Describe the change and give the chapter or timestamp to review.

## Design decision

Link to the change in `design/project.json` or its subsystem source. For a changed design decision, add a dated entry to `design/history.md` with the reason and what it replaces.

## Calculations

Run `python -m gpu_silo calcs` and commit `design/calcs.md`. Note any figure in the design basis that moved.

## Preview

Link the render run or identify the shot you checked.
